body:
AFAIU this is caused by https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/47542 (which brings https://github.com/jbossas/jboss-threads/pull/215), i.e. it's not JDK 25+20 specific and should be reproducible with any Mandrel/GraalVM for JDK >= 24.

@dmlloyd do you think we should "just" add the `add-opens` parameter in Quarkus when using jboss? Is there any chance we can add this in https://github.com/jbossas/jboss-threads/blob/main/src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/org.jboss.threads/jboss-threads/native-image.properties instead?

> AFAIU this is caused by [#47542](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/47542) (which brings [jbossas/jboss-threads#215](https://github.com/jbossas/jboss-threads/pull/215)), i.e. it's not JDK 25+20 specific and should be reproducible with any Mandrel/GraalVM for JDK >= 24.

Yes, agreed. Came to the same conclusion. We see it with Mandrel for JDK 24 as well. So a released version from here should reproduce on quarkus main:
https://github.com/graalvm/mandrel/releases/tag/mandrel-24.2.1.0-Final

> when using jboss

We will have to add it always. I would expected JBoss Threads to always be around.
